text: - A falsy Dioxus value (Bool false, Text `"false"`, Int 0, Float 0.0, None) of one of the bridge's 28 boolean attributes — upstream's private `is_bool_attr` predicate, a closed `matches!` set, since 2026-10-13-upstream-sync-polish-and-ship, which retired the bridge's own 27-name `BOOLEAN_ATTRIBUTES` list and left `mutation_writer.rs` byte-identical to upstream's at `434e0661`; `disabled`, `checked`, `hidden`, `readonly`, `required`, `multiple`, `selected`, `open`, `autofocus` and `inert` among them — removes the attribute, on the dynamic and the static template attribute path alike, so an enabled Dioxus control does not match `:disabled` and an element rendered `hidden: false` carries no `hidden` attribute, is laid out and stays in the accessibility tree and the snapshot, while a truthy `hidden` still excludes it (§4); a truthy value of a listed name is still written, and an attribute outside the list holding `false` (`aria-hidden`, a `data-` attribute) is still written as `"false"`; a framework-written `inert: false` is removed — `inert` the 28th name `dioxus_falsy_boolean_attrs` reads since 2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness — while a truthy `inert` takes focusability, hits and the tree away from its subtree (Focus order above; §6 Visibility and hit-testing; ratified by the founder (2026-10-18)) and Tab reaches the buttons under `inert: false` (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:1027-1054; tests/blitz-tests/tests/inert_subtree.rs:77-363; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/mutation_writer.rs:439-475; tests/blitz-tests/tests/dioxus_falsy_disabled.rs:24-39; tests/blitz-tests/tests/dioxus_falsy_boolean_attrs.rs:57-80; tests/blitz-tests/tests/dioxus_falsy_boolean_attrs.rs:130-150; tests/blitz-tests/tests/dioxus_falsy_boolean_attrs.rs:173-208) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-06-snapshot-state-fidelity/report.md and, for the 28-name predicate, escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-13-upstream-sync-polish-and-ship/report.md
